headword: {逆転勝利|ぎゃくてんしょうり}

definitions.gloss: come-from-behind victory; a win after trailing
definitions.explanation: A victory achieved after being behind, in sport or in any contest. Standard sports-news vocabulary, usually with {飾|かざ}る (to cap off) or {収|おさ}める (to secure).

examples.japanese: {見事|みごと}な{逆転勝利|ぎゃくてんしょうり}だった。
examples.english: It was a splendid come-from-behind victory.

examples.japanese: {九回|きゅうかい}に{三点|さんてん}{取|と}って{逆転勝利|ぎゃくてんしょうり}を{収|おさ}めた。
examples.english: They scored three runs in the ninth inning and secured a comeback win.

examples.japanese: {前半|ぜんはん}は{一点|いってん}も{取|と}れなかったが、{後半|こうはん}の{猛攻|もうこう}で{逆転勝利|ぎゃくてんしょうり}を{飾|かざ}った。
examples.english: They could not score at all in the first half, but a fierce attack in the second half capped off a come-from-behind victory.

notes:
{逆転|ぎゃくてん} (reversal) + {勝利|しょうり} (victory). A compact compound of the kind sports headlines favor, alongside {逆転負|ぎゃくてんま}け (a loss after leading) and {逆転|ぎゃくてん}ホームラン (a go-ahead home run).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {逆転勝利|ぎゃくてんしょうり}を{収|おさ}める: to secure a comeback win
- {逆転勝利|ぎゃくてんしょうり}を{飾|かざ}る: to cap things off with a comeback win
- {劇的|げきてき}な{逆転勝利|ぎゃくてんしょうり}: a dramatic comeback victory

USAGE:
Though it comes from sport, the word is also used of elections, court cases, and business competitions where a trailing side ends up winning.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {逆転負|ぎゃくてんま}け: a come-from-ahead loss — the mirror image, seen from the losing side
- {大逆転|だいぎゃくてん}: a great reversal — emphasizes the size of the turnaround, not the win itself
